title: Combining LLM and Dynamic Analysis for Universal Testing of Static Application Security Testing Tools
title_zh: 结合大语言模型与动态分析，实现静态应用安全测试工具的通用化测试

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型和动态分析的框架 LLM4SAST，用于提高静态应用安全测试工具的可靠性。 Static application security testing (SAST) tools help detect potential software vulnerabilities, but they themselves contain faults undermining reliability and usability. Automated testing can address these issues, yet current techniques suffer from limited program transformation diversity and lack mechanisms to verify generated variants, leading to reduced fault detection and high manual effort. We present LLM4SAST, the first universal framework detecting faults in SAST tools using large language models and dynamic feedback. Our key insight is leveraging LLMs to understand and transform code in diverse programming languages. We design novel metamorphic relations with transformations to guide variant generation, using an LLM to produce multi-language variants that satisfy these relations. To reduce erroneous variants and identify unique faults, we propose two heuristics: dynamic-feedback-driven selection and program-differencing-based clustering. For each metamorphic relation, a report-centric test oracle detects variants that fail tests and identifies underlying faults by differentially analyzing SAST reports of the seed program and its variants. LLM4SAST identified 66 unique faults across six SAST tools, with 32 confirmed or fixed after being reported to developers, demonstrating effectiveness. The proposed heuristics eliminate 47.8% of false positives, and LLM4SAST detects 3.4 times more faults while requiring only 39.8% of the variants compared to existing approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型和动态分析的框架 LLM4SAST，用于提高静态应用安全测试工具的可靠性。静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具有助于检测潜在的软件漏洞，但它们自身也包含缺陷，损害了可靠性和可用性。 自动化测试可以解决这些问题，然而现有技术存在程序变换多样性不足、缺乏验证所生成变体机制的问题，导致缺陷检出率降低且人工成本高昂。 我们提出了 LLM4SAST，这是首个利用大语言模型和动态反馈来检测 SAST 工具缺陷的通用框架。 我们的核心洞察是利用大语言模型来理解和变换多种编程语言的代码。 我们设计了带变换的新型蜕变关系来指导变体生成，利用大语言模型生成满足这些关系的多语言变体。 为了减少错误变体并识别独特缺陷，我们提出了两种启发式方法：动态反馈驱动的选择和基于程序差异的聚类。 对于每个蜕变关系，以报告为中心的测试判定准则会检测测试失败的变体，并通过差分分析种子程序及其变体的 SAST 报告来识别底层缺陷。 LLM4SAST 在六个 SAST 工具中识别出 66 个独特缺陷，其中 32 个在报告给开发者后得到确认或修复，证明了其有效性。 所提出的启发式方法消除了 47.8% 的误报，与现有方法相比，LLM4SAST 仅需 39.8% 的变体即可检测出 3.4 倍数量的缺陷。
